preview.boundary: Production fillDeepList and detail/highlight/group renderers only. Read-only explicit original-contract mock supplies 200 logical persons, 2000 physical person and queue slots, 38 cities, player king, complete kind-3 menu DTO and incomplete 13-property default person DTO, identity byteLength 207195. Fourteen actual-ID rows include a long full name, four-character names and equal names with distinct IDs. Fixture changes only Level/Arms of two persons then sets personProperties.custom, preserving menu owner and never clearing deepSig. Only private mobileHost isAvailable capability assignment is added. Lifecycle/configure/start/bind, actual bridge/LIB/WASM/storage/save/gameplay/physical devices are excluded.
preview.processBoundary: Exactly one owned Chrome context/profile and one private ephemeral allowlist HTTP server; only owned pages/context/server closed. No existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.

visualReview.notes: All nine original PNGs individually viewed. PC has readable complete names, existing Force/IQ/Thew direct text and the block Level/Arms line. Mobile at 844x390 and 667x375 keeps a single inner list column for eligible and custom fallback states, full four-character names, wrapped extreme mock name, separate 64px View buttons, independent right detail pane and visible Return footer. Updated-state screenshots show list bottom with last row visible and right pane/footer stable. The native custom flag removes both summary lines; only full names remain. No horizontal overflow, text ellipsis or hidden line was observed.
limits: No natural gameplay, native lifecycle, original LIB/WASM, storage, device or full-HD acceptance.
